article_name: Essential Documents Required For Ayush Counselling 2025
author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: Are you planning to study Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, or Homeopathy courses? You can get admission to these courses only through the Ayush Counselling. And one of the crucial steps in the process of counselling is the document verification.
Many students overlook the importance of documentation, only to realize lack of proper documents may even lead to cancellation of their admission.
This article is a guide to help you understand the importance and the list of documents required for Ayush Counselling 2025 .

sections.heading: List of Documents Required for Ayush Counselling

content.text: Refer to the table below and learn the list of documents required for Ayush Counselling 2025 .
The list has been prepared according to the guidelines of the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee, AACCC , the responsible authority for conducting the UG and PG Ayush courses counselling.

The above-listed documents are required for the All India Quota counselling conducted by AACCC. Some additional documents are included for the state Ayush counselling conducted by separate state counselling authorities.
Read further to find the list of additional documents required for state Ayush counselling.

sections.heading: Important Points to Note

items: All the listed documents required for ayush counselling are to be submitted to the college while reporting for admission. The original copy of the certificates and documents is only accepted by the institutions. Photocopies must be avoided.

It is necessary to produce the original certificates during document verification at the help centers. Wrong information entered on the application or different documents may result in the cancellation of admission.
The original certificates can be retained if submitted to any college during allotment, and the seats are cancelled or upgraded.

In some cases, the state counselling authority may instruct the candidates to upload the relevant documents during the registration process. In AACCC counselling, generally, documents need not be uploaded to the website; however, the relevant information is to be entered in the portal.

sections.heading: Additional Documents Required for State Ayush Counselling

content.text: Some additional documents apart from the above list are required for the State Ayush Counselling, which is conducted by the respective state counselling authorities.

The above are a few additional documents required for Ayush counselling, conducted by the state counselling authority. Make sure to go through the brochure of the respective state and understand all the documents that are needed for admission.

sections.heading: Documents Required for Ayush Counselling under NRI Quota

content.text: The candidates belonging to the NRI/Non-Resident Indian category shall submit the following documents in original while reporting to the allotted college for admission. The NRI candidates must attend the document verification with the following certificates.

sections.heading: Additional Certificates Details

content.text: The following certificates are submitted only if the candidate belongs to that specific category. These categories are considered for reservation. Lack of valid documents or proof will make you considered as a general category candidate, and you will not be able to avail of the reservation benefits set by the government.
The following are the categories and the valid certificates and documents required for Ayush Counselling.
Disability Certificate

The candidates with benchmark disabilities belong under the category, and they must produce the Disability Certificate/ PwBD Certificate , one of the documents required for Ayush Counselling, authorized by the Medical Board for 21 Benchmark Disabilities as per the Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2016.
An online generated PwBD certificate from the MCC portal will be issued by the designated disability centers. PwBD Certificate from any other hospital or organization will not be accepted.
Caste Certificate

The candidates under the SC/ST/OBC categories must submit relevant caste certificates issued by the competent authority. The students belonging to the SC/ST category need to submit the SC/ST Certificate , and the OBC category candidates must submit the OBC-NCL Certificate .
Income Certificate

The candidates of the general category, who fall under certain criteria of income, are eligible to apply under this category. And they must produce the GEN-EWS Certificate from a designated competent authority for the counselling.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: The documents required for Ayush Counselling for the year 2025 are listed in the article. These documents play a vital role in the verification of the candidates during the counselling process. Thus, it is mandatory to submit all the original certificates for the document verification, and during the joining of the college, without fail, to ensure that there is no hindrance in the admission process. It is advisable to carry extra photocopies of the relevant original certificates to avoid any kind of inconvenience.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
What documents are required for Ayush Counselling?

content.text: Some of the important documents required for Ayush Counselling are the NEET admit and score card, Class 10th & 12th pass certificate and marksheet, and Allotment Letter.

sections.heading: What is a domicile certificate?

content.text: A domicile certificate is one of the documents required for Ayush Counselling conducted by the state counselling authority for candidates belonging to their state.

sections.heading: Who should submit the domicile certificate?

content.text: A domicile certificate should be submitted by the students of the state they are applying for counselling.

sections.heading: Is the NEET-UG Score Card mandatory for the Ayush Counselling process?

content.text: Yes, the NEET-UG Score Card is mandatory for the Ayush Counselling process. Based on the NEET scores, allotment is processed.

sections.heading: Where will I get the Allotment Letter?

content.text: The provisional Allotment Letter can be downloaded from the AACCC official website or the respective state counselling portal, where you registered.
